facts.text: I enjoy hiking and being outdoors.
I will wear UV-protecting sunglasses and a hat on my next hiking trip.
I will check out recommended brands and invest in a good pair of sunglasses for my next hike.
I sometimes find it difficult to find shaded areas to take a break while hiking.
I will bring a cooling towel and stay hydrated during my next hike.
